abstract: A total of 843 consecutive boys (median age 12.7 years) who had undergone testicular biopsy at operation for undescended testis was followed into adulthood (median age 25.2 years) to examine for testicular germ cell neoplasia. Five cases of testicular germ cell neoplasia were identified, including 1 nonseminoma of the contralateral testis, which had been treated before surgery for an undescended testis, 1 nonseminoma found at followup, 1 seminoma and 2 intratubular germ cell neoplasms. Of the later 3 patients 1 had a 45,X/46,XY karyotype and 2 had abnormal external genitalia. Previous testicular biopsy from the patient in whom nonseminoma was noted at followup showed Sertoli cells only. We recommend that testicular biopsy be performed at operation for undescended testis in boys with abnormal sex chromosomes, particularly 45,X/46,XY karyotype, and in those with abnormal external genitalia. The pattern of Sertoli cells only in biopsies from boys does not preclude the occurrence of testicular cancer in adulthood.
abstract_ja: 停留精巣の手術の際に精巣生検を受けた連続する男児843例（中央値12.7歳）を、成人期（中央値25.2歳）まで追跡し、精巣の胚細胞腫瘍を検索した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍は5例で確認された。内訳は、手術前に停留精巣の治療を受けていた対側精巣の非セミノーマ1例、フォローアップ中に見つかった非セミノーマ1例、セミノーマ1例、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍2例であった。後者3例のうち1例は45,X/46,XY核型、2例は外性器異常を有していた。フォローアップ時に非セミノーマが判明した症例の以前の精巣生検では、セルトリ細胞のみの所見であった。染色体異常、特に45,X/46,XY核型を有する男児、および外性器異常を有する男児では、停留精巣の手術時に精巣生検を実施することを推奨する。男児の生検でセルトリ細胞のみの所見が認められても、成人期の精巣がんの発生は否定されない。
